verses.original: הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־ בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּֽן־ נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה בְּכָתְבוֹ֩ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֨ים הָאֵ֤לֶּה עַל־ סֵ֙פֶר֙ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית לִיהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·ber yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’el- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh bə·ḵā·ṯə·ḇōw ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ‘al- sê·p̄er mip·pî yir·mə·yā·hū baš·šā·nāh hā·rə·ḇi·‘îṯ lî·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is the word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words on a scroll at the dictation of Jeremiah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah . . .
verses.literalPt: A PALAVRA que Jeremias, o profeta, falou a Baruque, filho de Nerias, quando este escrevia, num livro, estas palavras, da boca de Jeremias, no ano quarto de Jeoiaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָלֶ֖יךָ בָּרֽוּךְ׃
verses.literal: This is what the LORD the God of Israel says to you Baruch
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR, Deus de Israel, acerca de ti, ó Baruque:

verses.original: אָמַ֙רְתָּ֙ אֽוֹי־ נָ֣א לִ֔י כִּֽי־ יָסַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה יָג֖וֹן עַל־ מַכְאֹבִ֑י יָגַ֙עְתִּי֙ בְּאַנְחָתִ֔י וּמְנוּחָ֖ה לֹ֥א מָצָֽאתִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tā ’ō·w- nā lî kî- yā·sap̄ Yah·weh yā·ḡō·wn ‘al- maḵ·’ō·ḇî yā·ḡa‘·tî bə·’an·ḥā·ṯî ū·mə·nū·ḥāh lō mā·ṣā·ṯî
verses.literal: You have said Woe is . . . me because the LORD has added sorrow to my pain I am worn out with groaning and have found no rest
verses.literalPt: Disseste: Ai de mim agora, porque me acrescentou o SENHOR tristeza sobre minha dor! Estou cansado do meu gemido, e não acho descanso.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ תֹּאמַ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּנִ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י הֹרֵ֔ס וְאֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ נָטַ֖עְתִּי אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֑שׁ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: kōh tō·mar ’ê·lāw kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nêh ’ă·šer- bā·nî·ṯî ’ă·nî hō·rês wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer- nā·ṭa‘·tî ’ă·nî nō·ṯêš wə·’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ hî
verses.literal: Thus Jeremiah was to say to Baruch This is what the LORD . . . says Throughout the land . . . I will demolish what I have built and uproot what I have planted
verses.literalPt: Assim lhe dirás: Isto diz o SENHOR: Eis que o que edifiquei eu derrubo, e o que plantei eu arranco, e isso em toda esta terra.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֛ה תְּבַקֶּשׁ־ לְךָ֥ גְדֹל֖וֹת אַל־ תְּבַקֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֡י הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא רָעָ֤ה עַל־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂר֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְנָתַתִּ֨י לְךָ֤ אֶֽת־ נַפְשְׁךָ֙ לְשָׁלָ֔ל עַ֥ל כָּל־ הַמְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּֽלֶךְ־ שָֽׁם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tə·ḇaq·qeš- lə·ḵā ḡə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’al- tə·ḇaq·qêš kî hin·nî mê·ḇî rā·‘āh ‘al- kāl- bā·śār nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’eṯ- nap̄·šə·ḵā lə·šā·lāl ‘al kāl- ham·mə·qō·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer tê·leḵ- šām
verses.literal: But as for you do you seek great things for yourself Stop seeking For . . . I will bring disaster on every living creature declares the LORD but wherever . . . you go I will grant - your life as a spoil of war . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E procuras tu grandezas para ti mesmo? Não as procures; porque eis que trarei mal sobre toda a carne, diz o SENHOR; porém te darei a tua alma por despojo, em todos os lugares para onde fores.
